text:
Jason (Sales): Heads-up — DeltaHealth asked if we can run a 2-week air-gapped POC in their sealed network. Key asks: HSM-backed license activation, signed bundles, offline delta patches, and a clear rollback path. Legal also wants SBOM + CVE scan report. Any blockers on packaging or timing?
Maya (SE): We can do it but need to clarify artifact sizes and whether they want a full image or delta-only delivery. Typical: full signed bundle + optional weekly delta patches. For a POC we'll prep one full signed bundle + two small deltas.
Priya (Security): Quick checklist: do they require customer-managed HSM (BYOHSM) or vendor-key is OK? Confirm SBOM format (we prefer CycloneDX), attestation expectations, and key rotation window. DeltaHealth usually requests PKI proof and signing key fingerprint.
Liam (Infra Ops): Offline upgrade requirements: signed manifest + bundle.sig (SHA256). Manifest must include artifact_id, compatible_with, and rollback_checkpoint. We support delta chaining but recommend max 2 chained deltas for POC. Sample manifest snippet (for their review):
```
{"artifact_id":"rdi-bundle-2026-03-01","version":"2026.03.01","compatible_with":["runtime-2.1","quant-8bit"],"rollback_checkpoint":"snapshot-20260301","signature":"sha256:..."}
```
Maya (SE): For signature verification we provide a verifier command:
```
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
```
Priya (Security): We will supply CycloneDX SBOM + CVE scan for bundled libs. Note: we cannot produce HSM firmware attestations unless customer provides an HSM with remote attestation; FIPS/HSM attestation prep adds ~5 business days and requires a PS engagement.
Alicia (Account Exec): Pricing: airgap packaging is an add-on for small POCs. Typical: flat $3k packaging + $1k per signed delta if manual signing/transport required. HSM integration and onsite assist are PS and billed separately.
Jason (Sales): DeltaHealth asked about upgrade cadence — they want quarterly patches but legal requires a 30/60/90 day security patch timeline. Can we commit to quarterly majors + out-of-band critical CVE patches?
Liam (Infra Ops): Yes. Commit: quarterly major bundles, monthly windows for critical CVE deltas. For out-of-band criticals we can ship a signed hotfix delta + patch manifest. Rollback uses snapshot restore; manifest will include rollback_checkpoint and we'll provide a rollback script which verifies signatures prior to restore.
Priya (Security): Questions we need answered from customer ASAP: do you require customer-managed KMS/HSM (PKCS#11)? Which SBOM schema (CycloneDX or SPDX)? Max acceptable patch chain length? Rollback RPO? Policy on offline telemetry (we will not phone-home without explicit consent).
Maya (SE): Logistics: we need 3 business days to build a signed full bundle after receiving model tarballs and env constraints. If we generate signatures against their public key, add 1 day for key exchange/verification.
Alicia (Account Exec): They also asked about license activation for offline installs — can we do time-limited activation tokens or HSM-wrapped license blobs?
Liam (Infra Ops): We support HSM-wrapped license blobs (PKCS#7 envelope). Activation flow: customer supplies HSM public key -> we produce license blob encrypted/signed to that key -> customer injects into node. Recommend 90-day rotation for POC, 30-day for production-sensitive setups.
Jason (Sales): Can someone draft a short checklist to send to DeltaHealth (key asks + deliverables + pricing + timeline)? I will coordinate kickoff.
Priya (Security): I'll draft the security checklist and provide answers for the questionnaire (SBOM, CVE cadence, signature verification, attestation notes).
Maya (SE): I'll prep build steps, verifier scripts, and replication notes for their infra.
Liam (Infra Ops): I'll outline upgrade/rollback runbook and sample manifests.
deploy-bot: artifact rdi-bundle-2026-03-01 created (pending signature) — upload link: s3://redwood-artifacts/prod/rdi-bundle-2026-03-01 (internal).
Jason (Sales): Great — Alicia, confirm packaging pricing and PS availability for next week? Looping in @DeltaHealth-POC to get initial env constraints. :thumbsup:
